title: Auto uses on save (VS Code)
summary: VS Code adds a missing unit to uses on save (source.addMissingImports); dropping an unused unit on save is opt-in and gated
intro: Read this when you want the uses clause to fix itself on save in VS Code. Saving adds the one unambiguous unit that declares an undeclared name; an ambiguous name stays a light-bulb choice. Removal of a dead import on save is off by default (enable it in the [pascal] editor.codeActionsOnSave block) and lands only once the index has caught up with the buffer. There is no while-typing mode.
